name: Blood Prince's Command sets Taldaram's Torment crit-for-caster to 100% (#577)
contract: Blood Prince's Command 704641 carries ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107), MiscValue 12 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT2), BasePoints 99 (real value 100, EffectDieSides=1), classmask (0,0,2097152) which matches exactly the 8 Taldaram's Torment ranks (800772, 802568-802573, 802580). SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 (SpellAuraEffects.cpp) targets effect index 1 of the matched spell, which on every Taldaram's Torment rank is SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_CHANCE_FOR_CASTER (aura 308) with a baseline BasePoints of -1 (real value 0). spell_effect_value queries SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue directly, so it reflects the live spell modifier without needing to cast or even know the target spell. 802580 (level 56) is the Taldaram's Torment rank a level-80 character owns per AscensionSpellProgressionData.h.

steps.label: Torment's own crit-for-caster baseline is 0 before the talent
Blood Prince's Command raises it to a guaranteed crit
